stem_book: Passage Q.(i) to (iii). The cell potential of a reaction is related as ΔG = −nFE_cell, where ΔG is the maximum useful electrical work and n the moles of electrons exchanged. For a reversible cell reaction d(ΔG) = (ΔV)dP − (ΔS)dT; at constant P, d(ΔG) = −(ΔS)dT and ΔG = ΔH − TΔS, so ΔG = ΔH + T(dΔG/dT)_P. (dE_cell/dT)_P is the temperature coefficient of the emf of the cell. (i) The temperature coefficient of the emf of the cell, (dE/dT)_P, is given by (a) nF/ΔS (b) ΔS/nF (c) ΔS/nFT (d) −nFE. (ii) At 300 K, ΔH for Zn + 2AgCl → ZnCl₂ + 2Ag is −218 kJ/mol while the emf of the cell was 1.015 V. (dE/dT)_P of the cell is (a) −4.2×10⁻⁴ V K⁻¹ (b) −3.81×10⁻⁴ V K⁻¹ (c) 0.11 V K⁻¹ (d) 7.62×10⁻⁴ V K⁻¹. (iii) ΔS for the cell reaction Zn + 2AgCl → ZnCl₂ + 2Ag is (a) −75.53 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹ (b) 83.53 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹ (c) 100 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹ (d) 200 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹
